title: Library Late Fee Calculator
summary: Given an array of integers representing the number of days each book was returned late, calculate the total penalty based on the following rules: if a book is returned one day late, the penalty is 1; if it is returned between 2 and 5 days late, the penalty is twice the number of days; if it is returned more than 5 days late, the penalty is three times the number of days.
statement: Given an array of integers representing the number of days each book was returned late, calculate the total penalty based on the following rules: if a book is returned one day late, the penalty is 1; if it is returned between 2 and 5 days late, the penalty is twice the number of days; if it is returned more than 5 days late, the penalty is three times the number of days. Return the sum of all penalties.
constraints: Charge one unit for a book exactly one day late.
Charge twice the days for two through five days late, and three times the days beyond five.
Return the total fee across all books.
reference_solution:
def total_library_late_fee(daysLate):
    return sum(1 if days==1 else 2*days if days<=5 else 3*days for days in daysLate)
hints: Select its multiplier from the three stated bands.
Add the resulting fee to the total.
The disjoint conditions cover every positive days-late value exactly once.
editorial: The disjoint conditions cover every positive days-late value exactly once.
